Name: Junimo Hut Fairies
Author: abelardthebard
Description:
[b]FEATURES[/b]
--------
- Fairy Companions: Store the Fairy Box trinket in a Junimo Hut to summon a fairy. Up to 8 fairies can be spawned per hut.
- Enhanced Crop Fairy Event:
    * Global Boost: Each Fairy Box in a Junimo Hut adds +0.1% to the nightly Crop Fairy event chance, up to a max of +0.8% (only the first 8 boxes on the farm count).
    * Local Boost: When the Crop Fairy event triggers, each crop within 8 tiles of a Junimo Hut gets +1 weight per Fairy Box in that hut, up to 8 boxes (+8 max).
- Configurable Sprite Style: Choose from 8 fairy sprite styles
- Harmony Integration: Uses Harmony for compatibility with other mods.

[b]
CONFIGURATION[/b]
-------------
All options are stored in a configs.json file in the mod folder. The file is generated after you load the game after installation. The file can be edited, or the configurations can be changed using the Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]
COMPATIBLE WITH[/b]
-------------
[b]- [/b]Elle's Cuter Companions
- Better Junimos
- Generic Mod Config Menu
- Feel free to share more as you come across any that made you worry!
